% !TeX root = main.tex
% Shared by all lecture files through main.tex.
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage[margin=1in,headheight=14pt]{geometry}
\usepackage{microtype}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,amsthm,mathtools}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{algorithm}
\usepackage{algpseudocode}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}

\graphicspath{{figures/}}
\setlist{nosep}
\setlength{\emergencystretch}{2em}

% A shared theorem counter makes references unambiguous within each lecture.
\theoremstyle{plain}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newtheorem{proposition}[theorem]{Proposition}
\newtheorem{corollary}[theorem]{Corollary}
\newtheorem{claim}[theorem]{Claim}
\theoremstyle{definition}
\newtheorem{definition}[theorem]{Definition}
\newtheorem{example}[theorem]{Example}
\newtheorem{exercise}[theorem]{Exercise}
\theoremstyle{remark}
\newtheorem{remark}[theorem]{Remark}
% The proof environment is provided by amsthm.

\numberwithin{equation}{section}
\numberwithin{figure}{section}
\numberwithin{table}{section}
\numberwithin{algorithm}{section}

\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\fancyhead[L]{\small\coursecode}
\fancyhead[R]{\small\nouppercase{\leftmark}}
\fancyfoot[C]{\thepage}
\renewcommand{\sectionmark}[1]{\markboth{\thesection\quad #1}{}}

% Usage: \lecture{number}{date}{topic}. Standard sectioning supplies TOC entries,
% hyperlink targets, and counter resets. Use \subsection inside a lecture.
\newcommand{\lecture}[3]{%
    \clearpage
    \setcounter{section}{\numexpr#1-1\relax}%
    \section{#3}%
    \noindent\textbf{Lecture #1}\hfill\textbf{#2}\par\medskip
}
